title: Lula Celebrates Major Offshore Oil Discovery Near Amazon as 'Passport to the Future'
detail: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva celebrated a significant offshore oil discovery near the Amazon region, describing it as a 'passport to the future' for Brazil's energy future. The discovery underscores Brazil's continued expansion of deepwater oil exploration even as environmental concerns over Amazon-adjacent drilling persist.

media.caption: Lula hails offshore Amazon oil discovery as passport to Brazil's future
